messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync q — for per-route analytics views, should route-level filters auto-apply when a user switches to a model-scoped view? Thinking about quota visibility and rollouts. Example: Route A has a saved query that filters to `model:open-v2`, but the route-level view default is `all-models`. If someone opens the model view, do we silently push route filters into the model view or keep model view pure?

Samir (Eng): my vote: do NOT mutate model-scoped views. Keep scopes orthogonal. We can provide an explicit 'Apply route filters' CTA. Silent application will be surprising and will break reproducibility. :point_up:

Lina (Analytics): +1. Telemetry and cohort comparison rely on predictable scopes. If we auto-apply filters we need to tag every event with the originating scope or we'll corrupt long-term baselines.

Ravi (DevEx): UX idea: show a slim banner at top of model view when route filters are present: 'This model view is showing results for Route A filters — 3 filters applied — [Remove] [Pin to saved query]'. Default the banner collapsed. For rollouts we should surface 'Pin to variant' quickly. :mag:

Maya (Product): sounds reasonable. UX question: if someone hits 'Pin to saved query', does that create a saved query under the route or under the model? Ownership/sharing semantics matter for permissions and quota attribution.

Samir (Eng): implementation thought: pin -> create a derived saved_query with metadata: origin=route_id, inherited=true, parent_saved_query_id=<id>. Proposed API:

```bash
POST /api/v1/saved_queries
{
  "name": "Route A — model:open-v2 (pinned)",
  "filters": {...},
  "origin": "route:1234",
  "inherited": true
}
```

The console can render a breadcrumb 'Pinned from Route A' and show an unlink action.

Lina (Analytics): for telemetry add fields: `saved_query_origin` (route|model|user) and `applied_by` (user|inherited|system). Also include `pinned_from` id. That will make it easy to slice by originating scope during regressions and quota reconciliation.

Ravi (DevEx): @console-bot can we spin a quick dev build with the banner + mock API fields so product can demo to SRE tomorrow?

console-bot: Deploy started: canary rollout to `canary/rollout-ui` at commit `abc123`. 2/4 hosts healthy, expected finish ~10m.

Maya (Product): awesome, thanks. I'll put banner copy and a small mock in Figma and tag you. @Samir (Eng) if you can add the `inherited` flag and `origin` string in the saved_queries schema that would unblock telemetry and the demo. We'll iterate on whether pinned queries live under route or model once we see how sharing looks. :thumbsup:
